post_operation: assign error return code (ret = -ENOENT) before goto error label
path_conditions: error/failure path: when idr_find() returns NULL, function jumps to advance_rx label and returns ret, which would still be 0 (success) instead of an error code
notes: qcom_glink_rx_data() initializes ret=0. On the !intent failure branch, it jumps to advance_rx without setting ret to a negative errno, so the function silently returns success despite logging an error. Fix assigns ret=-ENOENT before the goto.
